summary: NeuroSense Therapeutics filed a 6-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing that its Nasdaq Hearings Panel hearing is set for November 10, 2026, following its timely appeal of the October 1, 2026 Staff Delisting Determination. The appeal stays suspension, and shares (NRSN) and warrants (NRSNW) continue trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market pending the Panel's decision. The Company regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule; the only remaining deficiency is the $35 million minimum market value of listed securities under Rule 5550(b)(2). NeuroSense will present a plan to meet that test or the alternative $2.5 million stockholders' equity standard under Rule 5550(b)(1), and intends to request an exception period of up to 180 days from the October 1 determination. Watch the Panel outcome, balance-sheet remediation, and upcoming catalysts—a Health Canada New Drug Submission for PrimeC targeted for December 2026 and a Q1 2027 non-dilutive grant decision.
